DN15 · DC24V · normally closed

Explosion-Proof Solenoid Valve

Explosion-proof solenoid valve with a DN15 connection, G1/2 female thread and brass body. The DC24V normally closed configuration opens when energised and closes when de-energised. Working pressure is 0.04–1.6 MPa.
